title: Thai Answers
description: Evergreen, source-marked answers to the questions people actually ask about living in and visiting Thailand.

items.title: Where can I get a proper therapeutic Thai massage in Chiang Mai's old city — on a table with a face cradle?
items.summary: Every massage venue inside Chiang Mai's old-city moat (122 known from open map data), plus an honest account of what open data can and cannot verify: face-cradle tables, training, and therapeutic skill are curator-verified, one venue at a time.
items.content_text: The question is really three filters — location, equipment (a table with a face cradle, not a floor mat), and targeted therapeutic skill. Open map data answers the first; the curation layer accumulates the rest.
